scripts.stop:codexplusplus: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('codex-plus-plus.exe','codex-plus-plus-manager.exe') } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }"
scripts.rebuild:debug: npm run stop:codexplusplus && npm --prefix apps/codex-plus-manager run vite:build && npm --prefix apps/codex-taskboard run build:web && cargo build -p codex-plus-launcher -p codex-plus-manager
